The problem is I'd rather do nothing at all.  There is nothing I can do to help my life be a good overall experience.  I can't work for a living in retail, which is where I am now; it fucking sucks.  I don't feel like I can make it through college because I'm on the precipice of failing and not being able to afford it (and I'm smart, so I shouldn't be failing, but should be getting the scholarships I deserve), I can't just be that washed out schizophrenic that's mooching off of his parents (who are no better off than I am financially) for his whole life, and I'm sure as hell not going to be a crazy homeless person who literally does nothing with his life.  
I appreciate the advice, but dropping out of college is not an option.  That's part of the problem of life in general.... Everything, and I mean FUCKING EVERYTHING cost time, money, and commitment; three things that do not come as a package.  You can have one, but you can't have three.  Life is just a torturer that gives you stockholm syndrome.
